status: frozen before any Rust inference timing exists; amendments require a dated entry in `amendments` with the reason, recorded before Rust timings are inspected

host.power_mode: lowpowermode=0, on mains power required for measured runs

python_baseline.dtype: float32 on cpu and mps (upstream agent.py forces fp32 and disables autocast off CUDA)

primary_acceptance.baseline_runtime: pinned Python, device mps, float32, complete network incl. action head
primary_acceptance.candidate_runtime: laya-rs, backend metal, float32 (a separate fp16/bf16 configuration is a distinct measured profile, never the same-precision claim)
primary_acceptance.metric: e2e_ms = one complete system_one-equivalent request: preprocessing + device transfer + synchronized model forward + postprocessing + result construction; excludes load, warmup, routing and HTTP; device synchronized immediately before and after each timed call

targets.parity: all frozen tolerance gates in benchmarks/goldens/tolerances.json pass for the same weights
targets.repeatability: at least 3 independent alternating-order runs (Python/Rust, Rust/Python, Python/Rust), >= 100 measured samples per workload per runtime after >= 3 warmups, bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 0) 95% CI of the ratio of medians (python_p50 / rust_p50) must have lower bound > 1.0 in addition to the 1.10x point estimate

primary_acceptance.historical_comparison_minimum: 3 warmups / 20 reps as in the upstream harness; reported separately, not sufficient for the primary claim

secondary_reported_separately.cpu: Python CPU vs Rust CPU on the same fixtures, reported as a separate table
secondary_reported_separately.regression_flag: > 5% p50 regression on any matched secondary workload must be adjudicated by Fable before any broad performance claim

reporting: per-request latency p50/p95/mean/std with raw samples retained
ms/question and questions/sec labelled as amortized, never as latency
cold process start, load, first-call, preprocessing-only, model-only, e2e and (L3+) warm loopback HTTP as separate rows
peak RSS and MPS/Metal allocated memory
contended/thermal/interrupted samples reported, never discarded silently
prohibited: changing precision, context or head budgets versus the pinned config
deduplicating repeated questions without disclosure (published workload is duplicate-heavy by design)
comparing Rust Metal to Python CPU and calling it an accelerator speedup
using any M3 Pro number as evidence against the published T4 figures

published_t4_reference.environment: Tesla T4, torch 2.11.0+cu128, transformers 5.17.0, laya>=0.1.6 unpinned, fp16 autocast, one repeated ticket, alternating 3-option choice / noul
published_t4_reference.status: unverified locally; no T4 available; any claim against these numbers requires a matched T4 run
